Three years of work.
Five minutes of truth.

Our term is ending and the next Council will soon be elected. Before we hand over, one thing matters more than the rest: what you think. What these three years gave your family. Where we fell short. What the next Council must put first.

First, the record: ten pages, the finished and the unfinished. Then twenty short questions. No name. Change any answer until you send. After that it is final, and the live results open to you.
